    Two-observation orphanhood estimates using the Preston-Chen method

    orphanhood_two_preston_chen.Rd

    Internal worker for the Preston-Chen two-census orphanhood variant used by orphanhood_two(). It applies variable-r adjustments to the geometric mean of the two orphanhood observations, then delegates the adjusted proportions to the one-observation orphanhood conversion.

    orphanhood_two_preston_chen(
  prop1_not_orphan,
  prop2_not_orphan,
  age,
  ages,
  date1,
  date2,
  maternal,
  mac1,
  mac2,
  M,
  mlt_data_input,
  mlt_family_input,
  brass_logit,
  brass_logit_e0,
  HIV_prev,
  HIV_art,
  HIV_5q0,
  is.HIV
)

    Arguments

    prop1_not_orphan, prop2_not_orphan

    Numeric vectors with proportions of respondents with a surviving parent in the first and second observations.

    age

    Integer vector with lower bounds of respondent age groups common to both observations.

    ages

    Integer. Number of common respondent age groups.

    date1, date2

    Numeric decimal years for the first and second observations.

    maternal

    Logical. TRUE for maternal orphanhood, FALSE for paternal orphanhood.

    mac1, mac2

    Numeric mean ages at childbearing in the first and second observations.

    M

    Numeric mean age at childbearing averaged across the two observations.

    mlt_data_input

    Optional user-supplied model life table. Use with brass_logit = TRUE.

    mlt_family_input

    Character vector of model life table families.

    brass_logit

    Logical. If TRUE, apply one-parameter Brass logit smoothing against the selected or supplied standard.

    brass_logit_e0

    Numeric life expectancy at birth used when brass_logit = TRUE.

    HIV_prev, HIV_art, HIV_5q0

    Optional HIV prevalence, ART coverage, and child mortality inputs for the HIV variant.

    is.HIV

    Logical. Whether to use the HIV-adjusted one-observation conversion.

    Value

    A list with lx_estimates.

    Examples

    # \donttest{
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

panama_1977_1980 <- MortIndEst:::orphanhood_two_preston_chen(
  prop1_not_orphan = c(
    .9960, .9844, .9753, .9556, .9195,
    .8908, .8157, .7618, .6166
  ),
  prop2_not_orphan = c(
    .9949, .9903, .9794, .9608, .9316,
    .8967, .8450, .7746, .6781
  ),
  age = seq(0, 40, 5),
  ages = length(seq(0, 40, 5)),
  date1 = 1977.50,
  date2 = 1980.36,
  maternal = TRUE,
  mac1 = 27,
  mac2 = 27,
  M = 27,
  mlt_data_input = NULL,
  mlt_family_input = "CD_West",
  brass_logit = FALSE,
  brass_logit_e0 = 60,
  HIV_prev = NULL,
  HIV_art = NULL,
  HIV_5q0 = NULL,
  is.HIV = FALSE
)
head(panama_1977_1980$lx_estimates)
#>   age prop_not_orphan time_location mac    type age_mlt lx_interp
